note: For simple G and the constructed Program, [L] gives a Selected history with beta_0 = bar, couplings in B_m, density equal to the push at beta_{m+1} and the running law; the start is eval = bare beta with v = 0 rather than equality with rho^W, and Running is stated against bar + slope s_m, equivalent to [M]'s form since s_m tends to infinity.

structure Selected : Prop where
  path_shared (N p q m : ℕ) : m ≤ N → (A.rep N p m).path = (A.rep N q m).path
  represents (N p m : ℕ) : m ≤ N → A.Conv N p m
  starts (N p : ℕ) : (A.rep N p N).v = 0 ∧ (A.rep N p N).eval = bare (A.β N p N)
  steps (N p m : ℕ) : m < N → A.Transfer N p m
  reaches (N p : ℕ) : A.β N p 0 = A.levels.clock.bar
  running : A.Running
